name: Camping 101: Enchanting
summary: You can craft an Enchanted Lute, but townsfolk dislike camps in town centers. A campfire is needed to set up camp in the wilderness.

sections.title: A Campfire First
sections.body: You can make a fire the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you how, so seek a cooking trainer if you have not learned the basics.

faq.answer: You can craft an Enchanted Lute.

faq.q: Where can I try it out?
faq.answer: You need to head into the wilderness to try it out, since most folks dislike camps in the center of town.

faq.q: Why do I need a campfire?
faq.answer: A campfire is needed as the basis of your camp.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a fire?
faq.answer: Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check with someone who trains cooks if you have not learned the basics.

angles.text: As a cook, you can teach others to make the fire needed as the basis of a camp.
